product_summary: Pune (Narhe/Katraj, Maharashtra) partnership, est. 2011, 11-25 employees, GST 27AACFO9165G1Z0, IEC AACFO9165G. Real product lines per own IndiaMART site (optimusengineers.com): (1) industrial spray nozzles — air atomizing, full cone, hollow cone, flat jet, spiral full cone, SS316, 60-70 deg, 6-8 bar (core manufactured line, item code OEAA01, capacity 5,000-10,000 pcs/month); (2) quick-release couplings — pneumatic, hydraulic, flat-face, brass plugs, Parker-type, pharma SS316L; (3) camlock couplings — types DP/DC/F, dust caps, PP/PVC; (4) tri-clover clamps and ferrules, metal nipples, metal couplings, hose pipes, metal clamps; (5) FESTO-branded pneumatic components resold — VUVG 5/2 solenoid valves, DSNU/DSNU-S/DSBC cylinders, DGC rodless drives, HGPT parallel grippers, VAS/VASB suction cups, VN/OVEL vacuum generators, rotary actuators, valve terminals. Profile page self-describes as 'engaged in manufacturing and trading Hose Pipe, Metal Clamp and Clover, Metal Thread, Metal Nipple and Metal Coupling'.
role_hint: manufacturer_trader — manufactures nozzles, couplings and fittings in-house (own unit, ISO cert claimed, OD/ID grinding to 2 mm); simultaneously resells FESTO pneumatic automation components and imports substitute valves, so a mixed manufacturer/trader profile. No customs line available to separate the two flows.
comment: HS 848180 (taps, cocks, valves and similar appliances) is only PARTIALLY correct. It covers just one small slice of the range — the 5/2-way solenoid valve (better placed at 8481 20 00 as a pneumatic directional control valve) — while the company's principal manufactured line, industrial spray nozzles, belongs to 8424 20 00 (mechanical appliances for projecting/dispersing liquids), not to chapter 8481. Couplings, camlocks, tri-clamp ferrules, nipples and clamps are pipe/tube fittings and hose fittings (7307 / 7412 / 3917), also outside 8481. The FESTO cylinders, grippers and vacuum generators are chapter 84 but not 8481 at all (8412 / 8479). Per project rule 3 the company is NOT rejected for the HS mismatch — it stays in the base and the code is corrected to the actual mix above, verdict accepted_hs_corrected. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' (oil & gas and chemicals) is a MISCLASSIFICATION: the site positions the company in general industrial/process engineering — chemical process engineering, humidifying/cooling, desulphurisation and billet/bloom casters for steel, surface treatment, degreasing, phosphating, plus pharma SS316L fittings and factory-automation pneumatics. There is no oil & gas upstream/downstream product line (no wellhead, pipeline valve, API 6D/6A, flange or pressure-vessel item) anywhere in the catalogue; the closest adjacency is the chemical-process and steel-caster nozzle application. Trader signs are explicit and material: the entire 'Pneumatic Cylinder', 'FESTO GRIPPERS' and 'Industrial Valves' sections are branded FESTO third-party goods offered with quotation support and 'bulk and repeat orders welcome', and the profile page itself says 'manufacturing and trading'. Product lines MISSING from the declaration: spray nozzles (the flagship line), quick-release/camlock couplings, tri-clamp ferrules, hose pipes, metal clamps, pneumatic cylinders, grippers, vacuum generators and rotary actuators. All of the above is taken from the company's own website/IndiaMART catalogue and is therefore 'заявлено, не подтверждено' — no customs line, invoice or shipment record was examined in this HS-only review, so no product here is corroborated by a customs entry. Note also that the site's own 'Industrial Valves' page contains FESTO marketing copy (VUVG part numbers 8033531, 574367) rather than Optimus part numbers, which reinforces the reseller reading of that section. No registry, revenue or customs-volume research was performed per role scope; those fields are out of scope here and left null.
